CERD list of public schools with coordinates, May 2017 (HDX, OCHA Lebanon)

license: ODbL 1.0 for the OpenStreetMap rows (kinds other than public_school); CC0 for public_school rows. The derived table stays under ODbL (share-alike): credit OpenStreetMap contributors.

kind_notes.public_school: CERD public schools list (some rows are public kindergartens)
kind_notes.school: OSM school not matched to a CERD school within 150 m (private, UNRWA and others, or a public school missing from the 2017 list)
kind_notes.kindergarten: OSM kindergarten not matched to a CERD point within 150 m
kind_notes.university: OSM university; counts mapped campuses and buildings, not institutions

note: name is as published (English where the source has it, else the local name). src is osm:<node|way|relation>/<id> or cerd:<CERD number>. place_id is the nearest place in the Hub's places list within 3 km (see README-ADD). Polygons are reduced to their centroid. OSM schools within 150 m of a CERD school, or tagged public or government, are left out to avoid counting a public school twice. In this public copy the names of individual doctors and dentists are left out (the point stays), as on the Hub.
